jobs.description:
At Ball, integrity and trust are the foundation of who we are. Guided by our core values —"We Care. We Work. We Win.”— we create a culture where every voice matters and every idea drives progress. 

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe! 

Create a new future. Apply Today.
 

 
 

Position overview:
 

The role supports the EHS Manager to ensure and safeguard environmental, health and safety (EHS) aspects, fire safety and property protection (FSPP) sustainability programmes to ensure the safety and well-being of all workers and protection of the environment. Also he/she will provide advice and guidance to plant management on EHS, FSPP, and any other safety, health, well-being issues. Safety Advisor will support EHS Manager with daily management of EHS and FSPP risks to ensure the plant meets it compliance obligations and Ball requirements and implements best practice. The job position helps coordinate EHS activity.
 

 
 

Key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Point of contact for the external service personnel responsible for psychosocial aspects, occupational hygiene, ergonomics, and occupational medicine. 

• Assist in the identification of hazards. Provide advice on appropriate risks and propose possible (preventive) measures. 

• Provide training within the framework of a stable safety culture. 

• Provide advice and proposals regarding the purchase of work equipment, PPE, and the layout of workplaces. 

• Drafting the Annual Action Plan and the Global Prevention Plan. Maintaining records regarding occupational accidents and reporting them. Implementing the annual action plan. 

• Investigating workstations, conducting a thorough, in-depth examination of the workplaces and workstations. 

• Drafting safety instructions. 

• Providing advice and supervision regarding fire prevention. 

• Identifying, relevant, and inventorying risks. Supporting solutions and their implementation. 

• Objectively document and record on-site findings in a report. Collect additional information useful for the report. 

• Handle the administrative follow-up of the execution of assignments and decisions made. Gather and classify all documents in the file. Prepare reports in accordance with regulations. 

• Prepare risk analyses and job description sheets. 

• Organize medical examinations in collaboration with the external service.  

 
 

What Are We Looking For?
 
 

• Level I or II Prevention Advisor certification. 

• Experience of min 2-3 years as Safety Advisor. 

• Experience in industry. 

• Fluent English and Dutch.

Robert Half is currently recruiting an Implementation & Operations Expert (M/V/X) - Antwerp.

Our client is an innovative and fast-growing organization active in a regulated and highly specialized service environment. The company combines operations, technology, and compliance to deliver secure and efficient solutions for clients and partners across Europe.

The scope of responsibilities for this job as Implementation & Operations Expert (M/V/X) include:

• You coordinate the day-to-day operational collaboration with internal teams, external partners, and service providers to ensure smooth and efficient payment service delivery.
• You take ownership of the onboarding of new clients and partners, guiding them through the full implementation journey and ensuring a seamless transition into operations.
• You manage contracting, implementation, and service delivery processes related to work-related payment solutions while ensuring timelines, requirements, and compliance obligations are met.
• You monitor operational performance by tracking milestones, dependencies, risks, and issues, and you take proactive action to safeguard service continuity and successful delivery.
• You ensure the accurate and timely execution of salary payments, employee payments, authority payments, and other employer-related payment flows with a strong focus on quality and operational excellence.
• You identify opportunities for process optimization and operational standardization and translate these into scalable and efficient ways of working.
• You monitor service level agreements, service quality, and customer satisfaction, using performance data and stakeholder feedback to drive continuous improvement.
• You act as the escalation point for operational challenges and coordinate solutions with internal stakeholders, service providers, and external partners to minimize business impact.
• You prepare, analyze, and follow up on operational reports, KPIs, and management information to support decision-making and performance management.
• You build strong relationships across Sales, Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, as well as with external partners, to ensure effective cross-functional collaboration.
• You support the further development and growth of the service offering by contributing operational expertise, implementation best practices, and customer-focused improvements.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You hold a bachelor's degree in business administration, Applied Economics, Business Engineering, Economics, or a related field, or you have built equivalent expertise through experience.
• You have at least five years of relevant experience in implementation, operations, service delivery, project coordination, and/or process improvement.
• You have strong organizational and coordination skills, and you can manage multiple activities and stakeholders at the same time.
• You have experience working with internal and external stakeholders, partners, and suppliers, and you are comfortable acting as a key point of contact.
• You work in a proactive and structured way and are known for your solution-oriented mindset.
• You combine strong analytical skills with a clear focus on quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.
• You have an affinity with payroll, payments, financial services, or fintech, which is considered a strong asset.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English, and you build effective relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.

Robert Half is currently recruiting a Payment Infrastructure & Operations Expert (M/V/X) - Antwerp

Our client is an innovative and fast-growing organization active at the crossroads of technology, payments, and operations.

The scope of responsibilities for this job include:

• You ensure a stable and efficient payment operation by monitoring end-to-end payment flows and overseeing daily payment processing.
• You take ownership of the operational performance of the core banking and payments ecosystem and act as a subject matter expert for payment processes, systems, and controls.
• You investigate and resolve operational issues and complex exceptions by analyzing transaction data, reconciliations, payment statuses, and system information.
• You identify and implement structural improvements that enhance reliability, efficiency, and scalability across the payment landscape.
• You optimize, standardize, and document processes, controls, and ways of working to support operational excellence and reduce risk.
• You support business growth and change initiatives through impact assessments, testing activities, process enhancements, and system releases.
• You help maintain a controlled, resilient, and compliant operating environment by supporting internal controls, reporting, business continuity activities, and regulatory requirements

The requested qualifications for this job as Payment Infrastructure & Operations Expert (M/V/X) include:

• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in finance, Economics, Business Engineering, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related field, or you bring equivalent experience.
• You have experience in payments, banking operations, treasury, fintech, or another transaction-driven environment.
• You have a strong affinity with payment processes, operational controls, and system-driven operations, while experience with core banking platforms, payment systems, incident management, process improvement, or testing is a strong asset.
• You combine a strong operational mindset with analytical thinking and a hands-on, structured approach.
• You enjoy solving complex operational challenges, take ownership of outcomes, and keep oversight of the full payment lifecycle.
• You stay calm and solution-oriented in environments where reliability, accuracy, and continuity are critical, even when facing incidents, exceptions, or tight deadlines.
• You continuously look for opportunities to improve processes, controls, and ways of working.
• You are a collaborative team player who builds strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners.
• You communicate confidently and effectively in Dutch and English.

At its Ghent facility, Legend Biotech focuses on the manufacturing of advanced CAR-T cell therapies for the treatment of multiple myeloma.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have a Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences and experience with cell culture? Would you like to contribute to groundbreaking therapies that are changing patients' lives worldwide?

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

For our client, a biotech company that is a fast-growing & innovative organization, we are looking for a warehouse associate.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 

Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, …) in a controlled temperature environment.

Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies.

Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic

Fill out the Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for incoming materials including: transport unloading, temperature control, integrity control, administrative paperwork related to following correct procedures.

Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment.

Work closely together with the Operations and Quality department to support the Production and Lab activities for our start-up site.  

Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes.

Working in two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to process inbound, picking and outbound activities.

Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts.

At Legend Biotech in Zwijnaarde, you will have the opportunity to participate in the production of advanced CAR-T cell therapies, an innovative form of cancer treatment. You will work in a highly technological GMP-regulated environment.
	
• Working daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment	
• Ensuring the cleanliness of equipment and production areas
Performing various steps within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including:
	
• Cell isolation	
• Cell selection, activation, and transduction	
• Cell culture	
• Aseptic processing	
• Filling and finishing operations	
• Cryopreservation
Manufacturing clinical and commercial ATMPs (Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products)
	
• Adhering to all applicable quality and safety standards
Performing in-process controls on batch samples while maintaining the highest quality standards

Strictly following SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), batch records, and GMP guidelines
	
• Recording and managing GMP documentation to ensure compliance and traceability
Supporting environmental monitoring and the maintenance of GMP production areas

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Who are you?

You are a detail-oriented team player who enjoys working in an innovative manufacturing environment.

You have:
	
• A Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, or an equivalent field	
• Initial experience with cell culture	
• Experience in a GMP environment and/or ATMP manufacturing is a strong asset	
• Good command of English, both written and spoken	
• Willingness to work in a shift-based system	
• A hands-on mentality and strong attention to detail

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Coordinator - German + Dutch or French
jobs.description:
Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, French, Dutch and German

Conforma is a Contract Manufacturing Organisation (CMO) specialising in the manufacturing of non-sterile liquid and semi-solid pharmaceutical and medical device products, including solutions, syrups, gels and creams.
 

As we expand internationally, we are looking for an Outbound Sales professional to identify new opportunities, build a qualified prospect pipeline and support our commercial visibility.
 

This is a 
 hands-on commercial role 
combining market research, lead generation, outbound sales and business development. You will identify companies whose products could potentially be manufactured by Conforma, assess whether they have internal manufacturing capabilities, and identify the right people to approach.
 

You will help us turn market intelligence into concrete commercial opportunities.
 

Your responsibilities
 

· Identify and map potential customers across Europe and, subsequently, international markets
 

· Research companies, product portfolios and manufacturing capabilities to identify potential outsourcing and contract manufacturing opportunities
 

· Build and maintain a structured, high-quality prospect database and prioritise opportunities based on commercial potential
 

· Identify relevant decision-makers and map professional contact details
 

· Use online research, professional networks, databases and direct telephone contact to obtain or verify information and establish the right point of contact
 

· Support targeted outbound campaigns and follow up qualified leads together with the Business Development team
 

· Support the organisation and commercial follow-up of relevant international trade fairs and industry events
 

· Help keep Conforma's LinkedIn company page professional, current and engaging by contributing to relevant posts and content

We are looking for someone who is curious, commercially minded, proactive and not afraid to pick up the phone. You enjoy investigating companies, finding information that is not immediately available and turning that information into actionable opportunities.
 

· A higher education degree or equivalent experience in business, marketing, life sciences, pharmaceutical sciences, international business or a related field
 

· Excellent written and spoken Dutch & English is essential
 

· Strong research, analytical and organisational skills
 

· Excellent communication skills and the confidence to speak with people you have never contacted before
 

· A commercial mindset and genuine interest in business development
 

· Persistence and the ability to professionally obtain information
 

· Good digital and online research skills
 

· The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the Business Development team
 

What makes this role different?
 

This is not a traditional telesales position. You will not simply work through a predefined list of leads. You will help build our international market map from the ground up: identifying potential customers, understanding their products and manufacturing footprint, discovering where outsourcing opportunities may exist and determining who we should speak to.
 

Your work will directly contribute to Conforma's international growth and give you the opportunity to build a broad network within the pharmaceutical and medical device industries.

For one of our clients, we are looking for a Software Asset Management Officer to ensure the reliable, compliant, and cost-efficient management of their IT software licence portfolio.

The assignment combines administrative, analytical, and monitoring responsibilities, with close collaboration between IT, Procurement, and Finance.

The Software Asset Management Officer will contribute to licence compliance, cost optimisation, accurate reporting, and the continuous improvement of Software Asset Management (SAM) processes.
Key responsibilities

• Software licence management:

• Manage the complete lifecycle of IT software licences: request, approval, acquisition, deployment, monitoring, renewal, and retirement.

• Maintain an accurate and up-to-date overview of active, expired, renewable, and retiring licences.

• Analyse software contracts, licensing terms, usage rights, and relevant clauses in collaboration with IT, Procurement, and Finance.

• Ensure accurate administrative and analytical follow-up of SAM activities.

• Usage analysis & cost optimisation:

• Analyse software usage data to identify unused, underused, or oversized licences.

• Identify opportunities to optimise licence allocation and utilisation.

• Propose concrete actions to reduce software costs and avoid unnecessary renewals or purchases.

• Support the monitoring and optimisation of software renewals.

• Reporting & monitoring:

• Establish and monitor KPIs covering active licences, unused licences, upcoming renewals, compliance risks, and potential savings.

• Prepare analyses, reports, and dashboards to support management decision-making.

• Ensure SAM data remains accurate, reliable, and suitable for reporting purposes.

• Process improvement:

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of Software Asset Management processes, controls, and data quality.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to improve the efficiency and reliability of licence-management activities.

Ideal candidate

The ideal candidate combines solid experience in Software Asset Management, IT Asset Management, or IT licence management with strong analytical and administrative capabilities.

They can work independently, analyse complex licensing and usage data, identify cost-optimisation opportunities, and communicate effectively with stakeholders across IT, Procurement, and Finance.

What success looks like:

• 
The software licence portfolio is accurately monitored and kept up to date.

• 
Licence renewals are anticipated and managed efficiently.

• 
Licence compliance risks are identified and reduced.

• 
Unused and underused licences are identified to generate cost savings.

• 
SAM data is accurate, reliable, and actionable.

• 
Relevant reports, KPIs, and dashboards are available to management.

• 
Software Asset Management processes and data quality are continuously improved.

Mandatory requirements:

• 
Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience in Software Asset Management, IT Licence Management, IT Asset Management, IT Procurement, or a similar function.

• 
Good understanding of software licensing models from major software vendors.

• 
Experience analysing and monitoring software contracts and licensing terms.

• 
Strong ability to analyse software usage and licence data.

• 
Good knowledge of at least one analytical/reporting tool such as advanced Excel, SQL, or Power BI.

• 
Experience preparing analyses, reports, and dashboards.

• 
Fluent English, combined with French or Dutch.

• 
Strong administrative accuracy and ability to manage multiple cases efficiently.

• 
Autonomous and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership.

Strong assets:

• 
Experience with SAM/ITAM tools or platforms.

• 
Strong knowledge of SQL and/or Power BI.

• 
Experience with software cost optimisation and licence renewal management.

• 
Experience within a large enterprise or complex IT environment.

• 
Experience collaborating with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams.

Professional & soft skills:

• 
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• 
Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.

Autonomous, responsible, and proactive.

jobs.occupation: Innova - Business & Project Analyst - AI & Automation
jobs.description:
For one of our clients, we are looking for an experienced Business & Project Analyst - AI & Automation to act as a key link between Business and IT and support the organisation's digital transformation.

The role focuses on identifying and assessing opportunities to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation, and emerging technologies, translating business needs into clear solution requirements, and coordinating technology implementation across the organisation.

The consultant will support business teams in adopting innovative solutions that improve efficiency, operational capabilities, and business performance.

Key responsibilities

 
• Business analysis & requirements:
  
   
• Analyse complex business needs, challenges, and processes.
   
• Translate business expectations into clear and actionable solution requirements.
   
• Identify opportunities where AI and automation can improve business processes and operational efficiency.
   
• Assess potential AI and automation use cases based on their feasibility and business value.
   
• Act as the key interface between Business and IT teams.
  
 
• AI, automation & innovation:
  
   
• Support business teams in understanding and leveraging AI, automation, and emerging technologies.
   
• Evaluate different AI and automation solutions available on the market.
   
• Act as an advocate for AI and automation adoption within the organisation.
   
• Apply knowledge of AI technologies to complex business and operational environments.
   
• Contribute to broader digital transformation and innovation initiatives.
  
 
• Project management & implementation:
  
   
• Coordinate the implementation of AI and automation solutions across cross-functional projects.
   
• Define business expectations and coordinate with technical and implementation teams.
   
• Manage alignment between business stakeholders, IT teams, and other project contributors.
   
• Support projects throughout the lifecycle, from opportunity identification and requirements gathering to implementation and adoption.
   
• Ensure technology initiatives remain aligned with business objectives and deliver measurable value.
  
 
• User adoption & support:
  
   
• Support business stakeholders during the implementation of new technologies.
   
• Train and guide business users to ensure effective adoption of implemented solutions.
   
• Gather feedback and help identify opportunities for further optimisation.
  

Ideal candidate

The ideal candidate is a highly experienced Business & Project Analyst combining strong expertise in business analysis, project management, AI, automation, and digital transformation.

They are comfortable operating at the intersection of Business and IT, assessing the practical and commercial value of emerging technologies and translating complex business challenges into effective technology solutions.

Experience implementing AI or automation solutions within a large, complex or regulated organisation would be particularly valuable.

What success looks like:

 
• Business needs are translated into clear and actionable technology requirements.
  

 
• High-value AI and automation opportunities are successfully identified and assessed.
  

 
• Technology initiatives are effectively coordinated across Business and IT teams.
  

 
• New AI and automation solutions are successfully implemented and adopted.
  

 
• Business users are effectively supported and trained on new technologies.
  

 
• AI and automation contribute to measurable improvements in efficiency...
...

14+ years of relevant professional experience, or equivalent experience in a similar role.

• 
Professional experience implementing AI solutions within a large organisation.

• 
Strong knowledge of different AI and automation technologies available on the market.

• 
In-depth knowledge of project management.

• 
Strong Business Analysis experience.

• 
Ability to analyse business needs and translate them into technology and solution requirements.

• 
Excellent analytical and conceptual-thinking capabilities.

• 
Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Commercial Engineering, Science, or an equivalent qualification.

• 
Excellent command of English.

• 
Excellent command of Dutch and/or French.

• 
Ability to work independently, efficiently, and with a strong solution-oriented mindset.

Strong assets:

• 
Experience within the energy, utilities, infrastructure, or Transmission System Operator (TSO) sector.

• 
Knowledge of the Belgian or European energy landscape.

• 
Experience coordinating cross-functional technology implementation projects.

• 
Experience using AI and automation for business process optimisation.

• 
Experience training and supporting business users in the adoption of new technologies.

Excellent analytical and conceptual thinking.

• 
Strong project-management capabilities.

• 
Customer-focused and business-oriented mindset.

Strong problem-solving and solution-oriented approach.

Job Description

What will your day look like?

As a loader/unloader, you play an essential role in the warehouse operations. Your main responsibilities include:

 
• 
 
Loading and unloading trucks

 
 
• 
 
Handling and lifting heavy packages (physical fitness required)

 
 
• 
 
Working in a fast?paced and dynamic environment

 
 
• 
 
Supporting warehouse activities during day shifts and rotating shifts

 

In the long term, you will have the opportunity to learn how to operate a forklift and/or reach truck, offering great potential for growth.

Candidate Profile

Our ideal loader/unloader has:

 
• 
 
Good physical condition

 
 
• 
 
Experience with BT equipment (certificate is a strong plus)

 
 
• 
 
Willingness to work in shifts and occasional night shifts

 
 
• 
 
A hands?on mentality and proactive attitude

 
 
• 
 
Enjoyment in working in a dynamic logistics environment

 
 
• 
 
Fluency in Dutch or English

What does a reachtruckchauffeur do here? You keep goods flowing smoothly. As a reachtruckchauffeur, you move products, load and unload trucks, and prepare orders for shipping.

It’s a bit like being a traffic controller—but inside a warehouse. You’ll also check quality and keep things tidy and safe.

Are you the right reachtruckchauffeur? You have experience, a valid certificate, and feel confident on a reach truck.

As a reachtruckchauffeur, you’re flexible with shifts and communicate in English or Dutch.

You work accurately, safely, and like being part of a team.

Job Description:

As a Future Finance Talents Internship (FFTI) participant, you will be working alongside experienced finance professionals, contributing to various financial projects and gaining insights into the financial operations of a leading global brewing company. You will play a key role in delivering the main financial products of a Fast Moving Consumer Goods company that impact the company's performance. In 2025, FFTIs converted into full time hires and graduate trainees.

These work experiences will be located in Leuven.

Finance Areas You Could Be Matched With:

• Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A): Our Belgium, BNFL, and Zone Europe HQ hosts a high-performance FP&A team responsible for budgeting, forecasting, and enabling dynamic resource allocation to help deliver our operational and financial objectives.
• Accounting: We deliver a robust, timely set of financials on a monthly basis. Connect across our European Zone to help us manage by exception and automate our monthly and quarterly routines.
• Internal Audit: Jump into the beating heart of an on-going process or financial audit with our Global Risk Management team. Learn how the world's largest brewer runs from the inside out.
• Treasury: Work with our Global Treasury team based in Leuven to understand how we manage our derivatives, cash, and loan portfolio.
In all roles:

• Work-Experience Cohort: Our Future Finance Talent Internships are connected with one another to help create a strong network of young professionals. You will be integrated into operating teams and will therefore be able to leverage from operating team's experience.
• Weekly Masterclass: Regardless of your work-experience area, receive a master-class training from the functional lead of each area to ensure a broad-based understanding of Finance in a Fast Moving Consumer Goods company. (FP&A, Control, Tax, Sales Finance, M&A, Internal Audit, General Management)
• Capstone in Leuven: We will regroup as a full Cohort in Leuven to further cement learnings and ensure a strong network.
Skill-sets you will acquire:

• Data Management: Work with large data sets and support in improving financial reporting systems, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
• Process Improvement: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize financial processes and ensure best practices in reporting and analysis.
• Cost & Margin Analysis: Analyze production costs, profitability, and gross margins to provide actionable insights.
• Ad Hoc Projects: Participate in various financial projects, including internal audits, cost optimization initiatives, or strategy development.
• Collaboration: Work closely with finance teams in other departments (e.g., operations, marketing, sales) to gather data and insights relevant to financial performance.
